column8: Multi-tenant ops for CSP partners: tenant list; baselines; alerts.
Deploy standard configurations across customer tenants.
CSP lifecycle: customers, GDAP relationships, subscriptions; enforce MFA on all partner users.
Demo/trial tenants for partner engineers; never test on customers.
Time-boxed, role-scoped access into customer tenants via security groups; max duration + auto-extend rules; audit both sides. DAP is dead.

Identity (break-glass, CA starter set, admin hygiene), email (SPF/DKIM/DMARC, forwarding off, presets), endpoint (compliance + BitLocker + LAPS + ASR), data (sharing tiers, audit on), monitoring (alerts routed).
Refresh-token based automation into customer tenants; store secrets in Key Vault; rotation runbook; breaks when the consenting account changes MFA.
Remove GDAP + Lighthouse delegations + guest accounts + SAM consents; hand over break-glass; export documentation; end partner relationship last.
